title: Disco Ball Reverie
description: A surreal baroque scene features a large ornate disco ball hovering in a dark space. Below it, a woman in a flowing golden gown dances dynamically with billowing orange and blue fabrics while a formally dressed couple dances on the floor amid swirling blue smoke, scattered gold coins, and heavy draped curtains.
